name: sigelo-agent
description: Agent-side sigelo CLI: create an identity (DID), sign world challenges, collect attestations, build verifiable bundles

scripts.pretest: node -e "const [a,b]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number);if(a<22||(a===22&&b<18)||(a===23&&b<6)){console.error('sigelo-agent: node '+process.version+' cannot run .ts files; it needs node >= 22.18 (or >= 23.6). On an older node: npm run build, then node dist/cli.js');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(process.env.SIGELO_PUBLISH!=='1'){console.error('refusing: the npm account and names are an Owner decision (ROADMAP D1); publish the release/build.sh tarballs with SIGELO_PUBLISH=1');process.exit(1)}"
